facts.subIndustry: Integrated Delivery Network & Medicare Advantage Health Plan
facts.businessModel: Vertically integrated delivery system (34 owned hospitals, 214 ambulatory clinic sites, employed and affiliated physician network) paired with an owned health plan. Revenue splits 60% provider / 40% health plan; plan revenue splits 70% Medicare Advantage and Medicare FFS / 30% commercial and Medicaid managed care.
facts.mission: Deliver connected, measurably better health outcomes for the communities Meridian serves by unifying clinical care and health plan operations under one accountable system.
facts.vision: Be the region's most trusted integrated health system, closing care gaps proactively through data rather than reactively through claims review.
locations: 34-hospital regional footprint across Illinois, Indiana and Wisconsin
Meridian Medical Group affiliated practices across the same multi-state service area
strategy: 1) Improve Medicare Advantage overall Star Rating from 3.5 to 4.5+ stars by measurement year 2028
2) Begin modernizing the on-premises SQL Server datamart sprawl by evaluating Databricks as a future lakehouse target — evaluation-stage only, nothing implemented yet
3) Expand Epic Community Connect to affiliated practices to reduce interface sprawl
4) Reduce claims denial write-offs and RAF evidence gaps
5) Govern AI use cases with human-in-the-loop review as they move from concept to pilot
segments: self-pay and commercially insured patients across acute, ambulatory and behavioral health service lines

facts.subIndustry: Full-Service Network Passenger and Cargo Carrier
facts.businessModel: Full-service network passenger and cargo airline operating hub-and-spoke mainline service plus an acquired regional carrier, with a co-brand credit card loyalty program, cargo division, and MRO capability
facts.mission: Connect people and commerce safely and reliably across a global network, operated with operational excellence and a growing digital and AI-enabled capability.
facts.vision: Be the most reliable and technologically capable network carrier in our markets, with a fully integrated fleet, workforce, and technology platform following the Meridian Regional acquisition.
locations: Meridian Regional Airways regional network (acquired 2023, integration in progress)
strategy: Complete the Meridian Regional Airways technology and operational integration
modernize the data and AI platform (Teradata-to-Snowflake migration, governed GenAI expansion)
improve on-time performance and disruption recovery via AI-assisted IROPS
close the cybersecurity PAM coverage gap
segments: corporate travel buyers and travel agencies
airport station and ground handling partners
